page_title: CRE 1-1 ATA | Cremonese v Atalanta 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' It's a yellow card for Franco Vazquez (Cremonese).
90+3' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90+1' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) serves up a nice cross, but Marco Carnesecchi punches the ball away.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

88' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
85' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Franco Vazquez comes onto the pitch to replace him.

84' 1 - 1 Goal! Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Marco Silvestri is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:1.
82' Here is a change. Mario Pasalic is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Marco Brescianini (Atalanta).
82' Here's the change. Marten de Roon leaves the pitch and Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) comes on as a substitute.
81' 36:64 – the ratio of ball possession.
78' 1 - 0 Goal! Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) fires the rebound into the roof of the net after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.

77' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Silvestri shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
76' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta).

75' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alberto Arena has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Cremonese.
73' A substitution has been made. Martin Payero goes off and Francesco Folino (Cremonese) comes on.
73' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
72' The resulting corner from Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) is cleared.

72' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Marco Silvestri. The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.
70' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
70' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Atalanta get a corner.

68' What a big chance! Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.

66' CHANCE! Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
65' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

64' That's unlucky! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Atalanta will take a corner.
63' Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) sends a long ball in, but Marco Carnesecchi comfortably gathers the ball.
62' The ball rebounds to Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
61' Today's match ends for Mikayil Faye who will be replaced by Matteo Bianchetti (Cremonese).
60' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

60' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Marco Silvestri was alert and the score remained the same. Now Atalanta have a corner.
59' Alberto Arena blows his whistle and signals a foul after Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) brought his opponent down.
58' Ivan Juric has decided to substitute Charles De Ketelaere and he is replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).
58' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nikola Krstovic as he is replaced by Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta).
56' A goal, which was scored by Jamie Vardy (Cremonese), was disallowed due to offside.
51' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
51' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) is booked.
51' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) brings his opponent down. Alberto Arena has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Atalanta have a free kick.
49' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marco Silvestri, who smothers the ball.
48' The ball rebounds outside of the penalty area and falls to Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) who directs his shot to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is there to stop his effort.
47' Alberto Arena blows for a foul after Isak Hien (Atalanta) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Cremonese will take a free kick.
46' Davide Nicola makes a half-time substitution. Jeremy Sarmiento (Cremonese) comes on in place of Antonio Sanabria.
46' Referee Alberto Arena blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' A brilliant cross into the box finds Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta), who directs his low header onto the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
45' Atalanta are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
43' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
42' Marco Silvestri comes off his line to intercept the corner from Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta).
40' The Atalanta players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
39' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
35' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marco Silvestri intercepts the ball.

32' Romano Floriani (Cremonese) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
31' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
28' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
25' The corner kick from Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
23' > peeled away from his marker and got on the end of a cross inside the box. He attempted to head the ball towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper made a block.

20' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the right side of the goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Marco Carnesecchi.
20' A cross into the box from Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) is cleared.
18' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
18' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
16' A yellow card is awarded to Romano Floriani (Cremonese).
16' Referee Alberto Arena sees the trip by Romano Floriani (Cremonese) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Atalanta.
15' A clumsy foul by Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) and Alberto Arena blows his whistle.
12' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
12' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Cremonese.
10' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
8' Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
8' Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
5' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
3' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) heads on.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Atalanta will kick the game off.
Alberto Arena will officiate today.
